summary: Completed project lifecycle integration testing for Creabase platform. Backend: 58/58 tests passed (100%). Fixed 2 bugs in server.py. Frontend loads correctly. Admin login works via API. OAuth flow used for business/creator users.

bugs_fixed.issue: Missing endpoint function for /admin/wallets/{user_id}/transactions - decorator was followed by class definition instead of function
bugs_fixed.fix: Added proper async function get_user_wallet_transactions() and fixed WalletAdjustmentAdmin model placement

bugs_fixed.issue: /projects/{project_id}/deliver endpoint had no authorization checks - allowed any authenticated user to mark any project as delivered
bugs_fixed.fix: Added creator role check, project existence check, and ownership verification

critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is 5200+ lines - should be split into modules (auth, creators, projects, wallet, admin, disputes)
Payment processing is MOCKED - no real Stripe/Cashfree integration
File upload is MOCKED - no actual S3 storage
Notifications use polling (30s) - no WebSocket real-time updates
seed_data_creation: Admin user seeded on backend startup
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 58 backend API tests pass. Project lifecycle endpoints tested: create project (requires business subscription), accept/decline (requires creator role), deliver (requires creator role + ownership), approve (requires business role + ownership), disputes (admin can view/resolve). Wallet operations tested: balance, transactions, top-up (business only), payout (creator only), admin adjustments. Two bugs were fixed in server.py: 1) Missing endpoint function for admin wallet transactions, 2) Missing authorization in deliver endpoint. Frontend uses Google OAuth via Emergent for business/creator login. Admin can login via email/password API.

project_creation.notes: Requires business subscription (402 without), creates escrow transaction

project_accept_decline.notes: Creator role required, ownership verified, escrow checked before accept

project_delivery.notes: Fixed missing authorization - now requires creator role and ownership

project_approval.notes: Business role required, releases escrow to creator wallet

dispute_creation.notes: Business or creator can create, admin notified

dispute_resolution.notes: Admin only, supports refund_business, pay_creator, partial resolutions

wallet_operations.notes: Fixed admin wallet transactions endpoint, balance/transactions/topup/payout all work

admin_endpoints.notes: Admin can view users, wallets, disputes, payouts, analytics

mocked_apis_confirmed: Payment Gateway: Wallet top-up doesn't charge real money (no Stripe/Cashfree)
Escrow: Holds project amounts but no real financial transactions
File Upload: FileUpload.js has UI, backend /api/upload exists but no S3 integration
Notifications: NotificationBell.js polls API, no WebSocket real-time updates
